# `site_notes` — `/api/webmaster`

Notes on the Grove's websites: anyone who can preview a site points at a spot on a page and says what should change there, or suggests new wording; its owners and webmasters reply, make the change and mark the note done.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | [`/api/webmaster/notes`](#post-api-webmaster-notes) | Member | Leaves a note, or suggested wording, on a page of a space's website. |
| PUT | [`/api/webmaster/notes/{nid}`](#put-api-webmaster-notes-nid) | Member | Marks a website note done, or open again: whoever left it, or the website's owners and webmasters. |
| DELETE | [`/api/webmaster/notes/{nid}`](#delete-api-webmaster-notes-nid) | Member | Deletes a website note: whoever left it, or the website's owners and webmasters. |
| POST | [`/api/webmaster/notes/{nid}/replies`](#post-api-webmaster-notes-nid-replies) | Member | Replies to a website note. |
| GET | [`/api/webmaster/review`](#get-api-webmaster-review) | Member | A website as its preview pane needs it: its pages, its notes, and a mark that changes with its files. |

<a id="post-api-webmaster-notes"></a>
### `POST /api/webmaster/notes`

Leaves a note, or suggested wording, on a page of a space's website.

- Handler: [`add_note`](../../../backend/community/site_notes.py)
- Who may call: Any signed-in member

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `NoteBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `space_id` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 64 characters |
| `folder` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 4200 characters |
| `page` | string | no | `"/"` | at least 1 character; at most 2000 characters |
| `selector` | string | no | `""` | at most 2000 characters |
| `quote` | string | no | `""` | at most 1000 characters |
| `x` | number or null | no |  | ≥ 0; ≤ 1 |
| `y` | number or null | no |  | ≥ 0; ≤ 1 |
| `device` | one of `""`, `"phone"`, `"tablet"`, `"computer"` | no | `""` |  |
| `body` | string | no | `""` | at most 5000 characters |
| `suggestion` | string or null | no |  | at most 5000 characters |

**Response**

- `201`: a row of `site_notes`: `id`, `space_id`, `folder`, `page`, `selector`, `quote`, `x`, `y`, `device`, `body`, `suggestion`, `status`, `author_id`, `author`, `created`, `closed_by`, `closed`, plus `replies`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 404 | Website not found. | `a_site` |
| 422 | Folders go 20 deep at most. | `clean_folder` |
| 422 | Say what should change, or suggest new wording. | `add_note` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 422 | {folder} needs a page called index.html at its top. It’s the front page. | `site_folder` |

Marks a website note done, or open again: whoever left it, or the website's owners and webmasters.

- Who may call: Any signed-in member

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nid` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `StatusBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | one of `"open"`, `"done"` | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: a row of `site_notes`: `id`, `space_id`, `folder`, `page`, `selector`, `quote`, `x`, `y`, `device`, `body`, `suggestion`, `status`, `author_id`, `author`, `created`, `closed_by`, `closed`
